risk_reasons: The read scans refusal_events, a deny-all-RLS table, through the RLS-bypassing postgres role. Application scoping IS the access control (ADR 0023), so a scope defect exposes another account's decisions with no database backstop.

Per-location scope must admit business_id IS NULL without fanning one account-wide autonomy_suspended row across locations. That fan-out is the parent effort's exact defect (CONTEXT.md, Refusal source).
all_refusal_codes is non-owner-facing (ADR 0023) and RLS filters rows, not columns, so its redaction is application-side only and unenforced by the database.
The route reads flagged-draft subjects; a mapped or echoed database error body can carry moderation prose (query/parameters/detail) that may never leave the server.
Ships to an owner-facing trust surface whose whole value is being accurate about what RepWorth did not do. A false zero on this surface is the defect that killed the parent branch.
Rides staging before main per ticket #1014.
goal: An owner opens /dashboard/analytics/restraint and reads the Restraint tab: the selected window's total Refusal count and its breakdown by Refusal category, newest first within each, served by a single scan of refusal_events that renders the STORED category and never re-derives it.
non_goals: No backfill of any kind. #1002 decided there is never one, so refusal_events holds zero production rows at ship and the tab must read correctly against an empty table.
No re-derivation of a Refusal from any source table. src/lib/refusals/read.ts on the parked branch (six UNION ALL arms) survives nothing and is not harvested.
No write-path change. No worker file changes, no migration, no vocabulary change.

No owner label table or sentence copy in src/lib/refusals/vocabulary.ts. That file states the boundary itself at lines 30-33: presentation belongs to this tab, and a label map there would make a wording change a vocabulary change.

The <=90-day transition window AFTER AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED is flipped on, during which a selectable window can still overlap the pre-flip policy_gate_held hole. Deliberately deferred to a follow-up ticket; the disclosure line is flag-driven and disappears at the flip.
No disclosure of REFUSAL_LEDGER_ENABLED on the surface. Its absence signal is the structured log line (env-vars.md:563), an ops concern, not an owner-facing one.
No link and no instruction on the archived-location footnote. Reactivation runs assertCanAddLocation, which can deny, and enqueues a Stripe increment (#1005).
Not fixing the three pre-existing hand-spellings of 'autonomy_suspended' on main (suspension.ts:124, :311, context.ts:127). Main-side hygiene, outside this surface (#1000 ST-3).
No admin surface, no export, no filtering or search controls on the tab.
user_visible_behavior: A routed Restraint tab appears beside Metrics on /dashboard/analytics, as a nav of next/link links carrying aria-current, never role=tab.
/dashboard/analytics/restraint states the window's total Refusal count and its breakdown by Refusal category, newest first within each.
A held_draft row links to its review. An autonomy_paused row links to /settings/auto-approval. A no_permission row links to the contacts list. Every other row carries no link.
A row whose subject no longer resolves keeps its category and occurred_at and drops only the link.
The tab states a Coverage start line: accounts.created_at in the account view, businesses.created_at in a location view.
While AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED is off, a second line names the policy-gate lane as not yet recording. When the flag is on, that line is absent.
An empty window reads as one plain sentence naming the window and making no claim about all time.
The account view carries a footnote when archived locations hold Refusals in the window, and the footnote is absent when that count is zero.
A per-location view of a location archived during the window carries one archived-period line per period that intersects the window.
The tab states which number it shows, because an account-wide suspension appears in every location view and once in the account total.
The loading and error scaffold keeps the Analytics tab bar visible, matching /dashboard/analytics rather than vanishing as it did on the parked branch.
invariants: I1 — Invariant #12: src/app/api/dashboard/refusals/route.ts orchestrates only. It resolves scope, calls getRefusalLog once, and returns. No source query, no category mapping, no filtering.
I2 — Invariant #15: getRefusalLog receives sql as an explicit parameter. The route is the composition root and the only importer of the singleton.
I3 — Invariant #13: AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED reaches the browser as a boolean in the API payload. No NEXT_PUBLIC_* companion is added.
I4 — ADR 0023: all_refusal_codes is never selected, never in the response body at any depth, never in the error arm, never in a log line.
I5 — #995: the read renders the STORED refusal_category. It never re-derives a category from refusal_code.
I6 — Per-location scope is exactly account_id = $1 AND (business_id = $2 OR business_id IS NULL). Account scope is account_id = $1.
I7 — One autonomy_suspended row yields ONE row per location view and ONE row in the account total. It is never multiplied inside a single result set by a join through businesses.
I8 — #1000: no Restraint surface makes a claim about all time. Every sentence is scoped to the rendered window or to the stated Coverage start.
I9 — Neither the account total nor any per-location total includes a row belonging to an archived location.
I10 — src/lib/refusals/vocabulary.ts stays presentation-free and client-safe. This change adds no export to it and no import of it that reaches a runtime graph.
I11 — Tenant scoping is application-side. Every query in read.ts names account_id in its own WHERE clause; no subquery inherits scope from an outer block.
I12 — The route's error arm is withDashboardOwnerRead's fixed errorMessage. It never maps or echoes a database error body.

I13 — The account total and the sum of per-location views legitimately DISAGREE when an autonomy_suspended row is in the window (CONTEXT.md:165, LOCKED). The tab states which number it shows rather than forcing them equal.

I14 — Link authority is per-LANE, never per-category. Two lanes share the unsafe_content category (held_draft, and policy_gate_held via moderation_flagged) and both carry a response subject, so a category-keyed link rule gives a policy-gate row a held draft's link. The read resolves authority into a linkKind field server-side; refusalSource itself never crosses the wire.
I15 — Every Refusal query is bounded at BOTH ends of the window. occurred_at is writer-supplied, not a database clock, so an unbounded upper edge admits a row the displayed range excludes.
edge_cases: E1 — Empty window: one plain sentence, window-scoped, no absolute claim, never an error card and never an empty grid.
E2 — AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED off: the policy-gate disclosure line renders. This is production today.
E3 — AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED on: the disclosure line is absent. The pre-flip overlap window is a declared non-goal.

E4 — Account-wide suspension in the window: it appears once in each location view and once in the account total. A per-location sum exceeds the account total, which is correct, and the tab states which number it shows.
E5 — Archived location holding Refusals in the window: excluded from both totals; the account view shows the footnote; the footnote is absent at count zero.
E6 — Location archived and reactivated inside the window: the per-location view renders one archived-period line per intersecting period.
E7 — Location archived before the window and still archived: absent from the per-location selector, counted in the account footnote.
E8 — subject_id no longer resolves: keep the row, keep the category and occurred_at, drop the link only.
E9 — subject_id IS NULL (autonomy_suspended, C1/C2): no subject link by construction; autonomy_paused links to /settings/auto-approval instead.
E10 — held_draft: refusal_code IS NULL by CHECK C4. No code is shown, and no draft text, review text or moderation reason ever appears.
E11 — Subscription past_due: full access under a 7-day grace (invariant #11). The tab renders. perLocationActive is the correct predicate; the parked intake's claim otherwise was wrong (#1000 SC-4).
E12 — Impersonated admin session: the owner gate applies and the impersonation path is genuinely exercised, not mocked away at requireRole (#1000 SC-3).
E13 — Account created after the window start: Coverage start clamps to accounts.created_at and the window's stated start is the later of the two.
E14 — Location created mid-window: the location view's Coverage start is businesses.created_at.
E15 — Widest selectable window (90d / 12w) against the 180-day retention floor: retention exceeds every selectable window, so no row can age out of a window the owner can select.
E16 — Rows exist for a lane whose subject table was purged by offboarding: unreachable in practice, because a purge deletes the account's refusal_events rows in the same stage. No special case.

E17 — A Refusal whose writer-supplied occurred_at is after windowEnd (clock skew, a long transaction): excluded. Every Refusal query is bounded at BOTH ends, because occurred_at is writer-supplied and the tab displays windowEnd as the range it covers.

E18 — A policy_gate_held row sharing held_draft's unsafe_content category: it carries a response subject (C1) and the SAME category, so a link rule keyed on category alone would give it a held draft's review link. Link authority is per-LANE and is resolved server-side into linkKind; the component never re-derives it.
E19 — getRefusalLog called directly for an archived location: returns no rows. The route already 404s that case, but the read seam enforces I9 itself rather than trusting its one caller.

rollback_plan: The change is additive and read-only: no migration, no write site, no worker file, no schema change. Revert the squash-merge commit on main. /dashboard/analytics returns to a single untabbed surface and /dashboard/analytics/restraint returns 404. refusal_events is untouched, so no state unwinds and no data is lost. An owner who read the tab between merge and revert loses only the view. If the defect is scope leakage rather than a render fault, revert immediately rather than patching forward, because the exposure continues for as long as the route is live.
observability: Route failures surface as withDashboardOwnerRead's fixed error message plus the structured log line at context api/dashboard/refusals. The body is never a mapped database error, whose query/parameters/detail can carry moderation prose.

A scope defect is NOT observable at run time — a leaked row looks exactly like a legitimate one. Its only detection is the tenant-isolation integration tests plus pnpm ci:tenant-scope, which is why both are gate rows rather than optional.
Zero rows on the policy_gate_held lane in production is EXPECTED while AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED is off. It is not an alert condition and must not be read as an ingestion fault.

A ledger gap caused by REFUSAL_LEDGER_ENABLED being flipped off is invisible to this surface by construction. Its only evidence is the write helper's warning log line; this tab neither detects nor discloses it.
